title: Givens-coordinate views of a shared Neural ODE vector field
hypothesis: A single contractive neural vector field viewed through small orthogonal state-coordinate codes can represent multiple continuous dynamics with lower actual payload than independent mode-specific vector fields while retaining solver accuracy and throughput.
physical_object: One fixed tanh MLP vector field f0:R^8->R^8 (8-32-8), shared across 16 logical dynamics modes.
mirror_coordinate: One scalar angle per mode applies four equal-angle Givens rotations Q(theta); the viewed field is f_theta(h)=Q(theta)^T f0(Q(theta)h).
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen mode-specific ODE trajectories from one physical neural vector field; initial states are shared across modes.

task.view: Four orthogonal 2D Givens blocks with a common angle theta in [-0.75,0.75].
task.candidate_solver: 64-step explicit Euler; count 64 vector-field evaluations (NFEs) per trajectory.
task.reference_solver: 256-step RK4 on the same field and view; reference state is not part of inference payload.
task.field_generation: Per-seed deterministic random tanh MLP, weights scaled to produce contractive, non-stiff trajectories. No model training occurs; this is a frozen mechanism/storage/runtime screen.

controls: native generated-weight control: from the same base MLP and angle, deterministically materialize W1(theta)=W1 Q(theta), W2(theta)=Q(theta)^T W2 and b2(theta)=Q(theta)^T b2 once at load; this is an exact algebraic control for coordinate-view inference
independent full transformed MLP weights stored for every mode

development.selection_metric: mean relative trajectory RMSE against RK4 reference, actual serialized payload bytes, mode diversity, and steady-state vector-field evaluations/s
development.runtime_protocol: one-time payload load/materialization measured separately; warm up five trajectory batches, then time 15 repeats on one CPU thread.

storage.format: compressed NPZ, FP16 vector-field weights/angles and uint8 mode IDs
paid_objects: all persistent vector-field weights or per-mode transformed weights
storage.reconstruction: Materialized native per-mode matrices are deterministically computed from paid shared weights and mode angles; report materialization latency but do not double-charge reconstructed matrices as stored payload.

compute.include: Report zero training updates, simulated initial-condition examples, 64 NFEs/trajectory, one-time matrix materialization, and steady-state CPU evaluations/s. The arithmetic proxy counts MLP MAC-like operations and coordinate rotation arithmetic; empirical runtime includes tanh and solver overhead.

success_gate: Both development seeds: Mirror trajectory relative RMSE <=1e-3 and <=1.05x independent networks, actual payload <=0.80x independent networks, throughput >=0.80x the exact native generated-weight control, and distinct useful mode trajectories. Any exact native alias without an incremental benefit blocks a Mirror-specific PASS and fresh access.
failure_gate: FAIL if either seed misses quality, bytes or throughput, or if the native generated-weight control reproduces Mirror predictions and paid state with no incremental Mirror-specific benefit.
boundaries: This uses a deterministic synthetic contractive neural field and does not establish learned Neural ODE task quality.
No parameter fitting or near-convergence claim is made.
The native weight-generation control is expected to be algebraically equivalent; its runtime and reconstruction costs are measured explicitly.
Fresh worlds stay sealed unless both development seeds pass all gates.
